players.product: InP laser chips (CW / DFB / EML) with in-house InP epitaxy for silicon-photonics and 800G / 1.6T optical modules

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 results: revenue RMB 601.43 million, up 138.50% YoY (2024: RMB 252.17 million); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 190.92 million versus a loss of RMB 6.13 million in 2024; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 167.22 million; overall gross margin 58.11%. The company attributes the growth mainly to data-center revenue (higher-margin CW light-source products) rising as a share of sales; operating cash flow RMB 150.24 million (+692.34%).
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 601.43 million (+138.50% YoY); net profit RMB 190.92 million; gross margin 58.11%

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 by quarter - revenue: Q1 RMB 84.40 million, Q2 RMB 120.55 million, Q3 RMB 178.30 million, Q4 RMB 218.19 million; net profit attributable to shareholders: Q1 RMB 14.32 million, Q2 RMB 31.94 million, Q3 RMB 59.63 million, Q4 RMB 85.03 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 2025 revenue RMB 218.19 million; Q4 net profit RMB 85.03 million

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 by market: data-center products revenue RMB 393.26 million, up 719.06% YoY, gross margin 72.21%, now over 50% of revenue - the main product is the high-power CW laser chip used in silicon-photonics module solutions. Telecom products revenue RMB 206.47 million, up 2.06%, gross margin 31.17%; its 25G/50G PON laser chips were delivered in volume and formed scale revenue, and EML products have become an important part of telecom revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: data center RMB 393.26 million (+719.06%, GM 72.21%); telecom RMB 206.47 million (+2.06%, GM 31.17%)

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 production and sales volume: data-center chips produced 1,926 ten-thousand units (+738.04%) and sold 1,772 ten-thousand units (+675.70%), ending inventory 161 ten-thousand; telecom chips produced 3,112 ten-thousand units (-11.44%) and sold 3,571 ten-thousand units (-28.46%), ending inventory 1,400 ten-thousand.

Data-center products in 2025 (company): CW 70mW laser chips (uncooled, high output power, low power consumption) were delivered in large volume and are the data-center business's main product; CW 100mW laser chips were also delivered in volume; for pluggable silicon-photonics modules, 2025 demand was mainly for 70mW light sources. The 100G PAM4 EML completed customer validation and the higher-speed 200G PAM4 EML began customer validation.
quarterly_data.figure: CW 70mW and 100mW in volume delivery; 200G PAM4 EML in customer validation

quarterly_data.signal: CPO / NPO (company): it has developed higher-power CW light sources such as 300mW for co-packaged / near-packaged optics, which it sees as one solution for 1.6T and above, and is further learning customer requirements to complete the related development; it has started pre-research on CW laser chips for OIO (optical I/O). R&D project 'industrial 100mW silicon-photonics laser / 300mW CW Laser for ELS' (budget RMB 6,568.00 ten-thousand, RMB 4,526.98 ten-thousand invested to date) is at the mass-production-capable / yield-optimisation and product-development stages.
quarterly_data.figure: 300mW CW light source; ELS project budget RMB 6,568.00 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers were 71.80% of 2025 sales (RMB 43,185.68 ten-thousand); the largest 53.35% (RMB 32,084.71 ten-thousand), then 6.64%, 4.59%, 3.71% and 3.52%; names not disclosed; 0% of sales from related parties. Company: the first and second customers are data-center-market makers and the third to fifth mainly telecom-market customers; the second, third and fourth customers were new to the top five in 2025; concentration rose as data-center products ramped, and the company says it does not depend heavily on a few customers.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers 71.80% of 2025 sales; largest 53.35%

quarterly_data.signal: Top five suppliers were 48.09% of 2025 purchases (RMB 8,311.64 ten-thousand): 11.97%, 9.99%, 9.30%, 9.00% and 7.83%; names not disclosed; 0% from related parties. Company: part of the equipment and raw materials it needs come from overseas suppliers, and it is gradually raising the share of domestic suppliers.

Major sales contracts (the report's table of signed major sales contracts): three contracts for high-power laser chip products with an undisclosed 'Customer A' - one of them with Customer A and its subsidiaries - all performing normally at end-2025, each partly performed in 2025 with an amount still to be performed.

2025 R&D spend RMB 80.84 million, up 48.29%, 13.44% of revenue (2024: 21.62%); 106 R&D staff (14.80% of headcount). R&D project '100G/200G EML laser development' (budget RMB 7,490.00 ten-thousand, RMB 6,160.00 ten-thousand invested to date) is at the customer-validation stage.

Capacity build-out: the company kept buying wafer-process and chip-process equipment in 2025 to expand capacity. Construction in progress was RMB 156.39 million at end-2025 (+258.28%), mainly equipment delivered but not yet put into service; prepaid equipment and works (other non-current assets) RMB 201.99 million (+1,104.65%). The 50G optical chip industrialization project (76.69% of budget invested, under construction) is scheduled to reach ready-for-use status in December 2026; the 10G/25G optical chip line project reached it in December 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: 50G project 76.69% of budget invested, ready December 2026

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue by region: domestic RMB 598.89 million (gross margin 58.11%), overseas RMB 1.91 million; the company says its direct sales to the US are small. Its US subsidiary YST Semiconductor Technology Corporation (optical chip production and sales) posted a 2025 net loss of RMB 408.73 ten-thousand; overseas assets were 15.99% of total assets.
quarterly_data.figure: domestic revenue RMB 598.89 million; overseas RMB 1.91 million

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (company): expand capacity through the Phase II R&D and production base for optoelectronic communication semiconductor chips and devices - approved by shareholders on March 2, 2026 with total investment of about RMB 12.51 hundred million (subject to actual spend) - buying core equipment to raise high-end laser-chip capacity, and push ahead with overseas plant construction in an orderly way; focus R&D and commercialisation on higher-power CW light sources and high-speed EML lasers for 800G / 1.6T modules and NPO / CPO packaging, and widen global customer coverage to match high-speed optical-interconnect demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Phase II investment about RMB 12.51 hundred million
